Arrive early to have a choice.
Dec 2023 • Family
This establishment offers a narrow facade with a security guard at the entrance. Once you pass the door, you find yourself in front of a stall of fish and shellfish that will whet your appetite. Next is the restaurant room whose walls are covered with blue and white earthenware; it feels like we're in Brittany even if the boss is from the south of France. We have the choice between 3 starters and 3 main courses but there were only 2 starters and 2 main courses left at 2 p.m. Smiling waiter, good food and you can buy your fish, mussels or oysters on the way out. We tried the mussels which were excellent.

Western-style treat
Sep 2023 • Couples
If you are in the mood for Western-style fish and seafood, this restaurant comes highly recommended (by me). When you enter the premises, there is a large selection of fresh fish and seafood to choose from, including oysters imported from France (along with local ones). Everything is prepared to the highest standards and there is also a variety of delicious side dishes to choose from (e.g., green beans sautéed in butter with garlic, yum, yum). Last but not least, the wine list is quite extensive for such a (smaller) restaurant and very fairly priced. To put my money where my mouth is, so to speak, I have made another reservation for tomorrow night.

Heavenly seafood!
May 2023 • Couples
Definitely one of the best seafood I’ve had. I would like to give it more than 5 stars. Clean, simple yet elegant, authentic taste, great wine pairing, lovely service. Can’t say enough. The oysters heavenly. The lobsters, tiger prawns… cooked to perfection. The price was very reasonable compared to the quality. I paid much more money elsewhere for half the portion and the taste that I experienced in this restaurant. Definitely a place not to be missed. Make sure you make reservations because there aren’t many tables.
